Metadata.Title: RDS PostgreSQL 5432 least-privilege Security Group policy
Metadata.ThreatModel: Bot quet Internet lien tuc do port 5432 tren IPv4 cong khai. Neu mo 0.0.0.0/0, RDS bi brute-force trong vai phut. Policy nay chi cho phep dung IP /32 co dinh cua nhom dev va Security Group cua Backend; moi nguon khac bi DROP tai lop SG (client thay 'Connection timed out').

TargetSecurityGroup.Vpc: Default VPC of ap-southeast-1 (created by infra/aws/terraform_rds.tf - P2-Q01)
TargetSecurityGroup.ManagedBy: Terraform (P2-Q01) owns the SG shell; P2-Q02 owns the ingress rules only
TargetSecurityGroup.StatefulNote: Security Group la stateful: goi tin phan hoi cua ket noi inbound duoc phep tu dong, nen egress deny-all KHONG lam hong ket noi psql.

AuthorizeIngress.CliTarget: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id <SG_ID> --ip-permissions <mang IpPermissions duoi day>
AuthorizeIngress.ShapeNotice: Moi phan tu PHAI dung shape AWS IpPermission: CIDR nam trong IpRanges[].CidrIp, mo ta nam trong IpRanges[].Description. Dat 'CidrIp'/'Description' o cap ngoai se bi CLI tu choi (Unknown parameter).
AuthorizeIngress.LeastPrivilegeRationale: Moi nguon la mot /32 duy nhat (khong dung CIDR rong), chi 1 port duy nhat 5432, chi giao thuc tcp. Mot rule = mot nguoi/mot SG -> revoke chinh xac khi offboarding.

IpRanges.Description: P2-Q02 dev-01 Quang fixed IP (verified 2026-11-02 via checkip.amazonaws.com)

AuthorizeIngress.AppliedStatePolicy: Rule dang ky la IP that cua may dev, da ap dung len SG ngay 2026-11-02 (xem security_groups.md muc 8.4). Them IP moi = them 1 phan tu vao mang nay (moi IP 1 rule /32, tran MaxIngressRules = 5) roi chay lint + muc 6.4. Khong bao gio dung 203.0.113.x (dai tai lieu RFC 5737, khong dinh tuyen duoc) trong rule that.

AuthorizeIngressDeferred.ApplyWhen: P3-Q02 (Backend FastAPI len AWS App Runner) da tao Security Group cho backend
AuthorizeIngressDeferred.Reason: Backend SG chua ton tai o Phase 2. Rule tham chieu SG duoc khai bao san de sau nay khong phai mo public IP cua App Runner.
AuthorizeIngressDeferred.CliTarget: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id <SG_ID> --ip-permissions <mang IpPermissions duoi day>

UserIdGroupPairs.Description: Backend API SG (App Runner VPC connector / EC2) - P3-Q02

AuthorizeIngressDeferred.PlaceholderPolicy: GroupId 'sg-BACKEND_SG_ID_PLACEHOLDER' khong ton tai -> CLI bao InvalidGroup.NotFound neu apply som. Do NOT apply truoc P3-Q02.

AuthorizeEgress.CliTarget: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id <SG_ID> --ip-permissions <mang IpPermissions duoi day>
AuthorizeEgress.Rationale: RDS khong bao gio chu dong mo ket noi ra ngoai. Egress deny-all (shell trong terraform_rds.tf dung 127.0.0.1/32) chan luon duong data-exfiltration. Mang rong o day nghia la 'khong them rule egress nao'.

ComplianceGuards.ForbiddenSourceSecurityGroupIdsWhy: launch-wizard-1 - SG mo SSH tu 0.0.0.0/0, khong bao gio duoc lam nguon cho RDS.

ForbiddenRuleExamples_DO_NOT_APPLY.Why: Mo PostgreSQL cho toan bo Internet - vi pham truc tiep Acceptance Criteria, la nguyen nhan so 1 khien RDS bi ma hoa to cong khai.
Mo ca dai IPv6 Internet, tuong duong 0.0.0.0/0 nhung de bi bo sot khi audit.
Mo 'all traffic' thay vi chi 5432 - bien DB thanh be mat tan cong toan bo port (co Description day du nen chi vi pham protocol/port).
Nguon qua rong (ca dai /16 cua ISP) - bat ky khach hang nao cua ISP do cung vao duoc DB.
Dung SG mo cua (launch-wizard-1) lam nguon - vi pham least privilege qua 2 lop.
